line: Crowley's Knight of Wands: Yodh of the Name (pdf p139); the fiery part of Fire and the span from Scorpio to Sagittarius (pdf p141).

sections.title: The court and its element
sections.line: Crowley on the Knights (pdf p139) and on the Knight of Wands (pdf p141).

quotes.quote: The Knights represent the powers of the letter Yodh in the Name.
The Knight of Wands represents the fiery part of Fire

sections.title: Its span in the Zodiac
sections.line: Crowley on the span from the 21st degree of Scorpio to the 20th degree of Sagittarius (pdf p141); on the decans and the elemental attribution (pdf p139).

quotes.quote: he rules from the 21St degree of Scorpio to the 20th degree of Sagittarius
instead of assigning the three decans of each sign to one card, the influence begins with the last decan of one Sign and continues to the second decan of the next.
It might well be expected that the elemental attribution would harmonize with the Zodiacal attribution; but it is not so.

sections.title: Character
sections.line: Crowley on the character of the Knight of Wands (pdf p141).

quotes.quote: The moral qualities appropriate to this figure are activity, generosity, fierceness, impetuosity, pride
